verdict.rationale: Groq can serve custom fine-tuned behavior: you upload existing LoRA adapters and run inference on them on Groq infrastructure. However, the docs describe only 'pre-made' adapters, so the fine-tuning itself has to happen elsewhere. That covers only the serving half of the story. Missing for 10: on-platform fine-tuning on user data, a list of supported base models for adapters, and independent or hands-on corroboration of LoRA serving.
